cases.name: graph-added-removed-project
cases.error: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
cases.reason: The pinned Go builder dereferences a nil buildInfoEntry at buildtask.go:894 after a previously built project acquires a missing reference. C# reports TS6053 and continues compilation, matching the forced-build control output and status, then recovers when the reference is restored. The complete input and both output sequences are hash-bound; only the raw panic stack addresses are excluded from the reference hash and the stack is retained.

cases.name: new-root-preserved-timestamp
cases.reason: The pinned Go timestamp shortcut ignores a newly discovered root whose mtime predates the previous build-info, including a file created during an in-flight build. C# also checks root membership and compiles the added file. Accumulated JS, declarations and complete build-info must match the forced Go control exactly.
